content.title: About
content.content: Carrot juice, 100% is a pure juice extracted from fresh carrots without added sugars, preservatives or flavorings. It has a bright orange colour, a mildly sweet taste and the characteristic aroma of carrots.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Carrot juice is rich in beta‑carotene, which the body converts into vitamin A.
The deep orange colour comes from high levels of carotenoids.
It is often used in baby foods because of its gentle flavour and nutritional value.
In the 19th century carrot juice was promoted as a remedy for improving eyesight.
The juice can be frozen while retaining most of its nutrients.

items.title: Supports vision
items.content: Beta‑carotene, converted to vitamin A, is essential for retinal health and night vision.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Carotenoids and vitamin C help neutralise free radicals, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Immune system support
items.content: Vitamin C boosts immune response and aids collagen synthesis.

items.title: Skin health
items.content: Vitamin A and antioxidants promote skin renewal and may improve appearance.

items.title: Reduced risk of chronic diseases
items.content: Phytochemicals in carrots may help lower the risk of cardiovascular disease and certain cancers.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience an allergic reaction to carrots.

items.title: High natural sugar content
items.content: Although no sugar is added, the natural sugars can raise the glycemic index, which is relevant for diabetics.

items.title: Loss of dietary fiber
items.content: Juicing removes much of the fiber, so juice does not replace whole carrots in the diet.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Drink the juice chilled, add it to smoothies, cocktails, sauces or soups. To balance sweetness, mix with a splash of lemon juice or ginger.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the juice in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C in a sealed container for up to 3‑5 days. Freeze in airtight containers for longer storage.
